question: In which chapter is the Curio (珍玩) Beasts and Buddha obtained?

rollouts.answer: The curio 兽与佛 ("Beasts and Buddha") is obtained in Chapter 3, 夜生白露, appearing in the talisman/curio menu at about 39,900s during the 小雷音寺 section.

db_evidence.notes: visual_clips rows 001329 (39870-39900) and 001330 (39900-39930) explicitly name '兽与佛' (rendered in captions as a horned beast mask / 'Beast and Buddha') in the in-game talisman/curio selection menu, directly overlapping the clue interval 39867-39894. episodes rows carry title-card text: '第三回 风都黄昏' first appears at 21420s, and the game continues under '第三回' (with drifting in-episode subtitle spellings 风起黄昏 / 夜生白露 / 夜半白露 / 牧生白露 / 风起黄泉, all inconsistent OCR/caption variants of the same chapter-3 arc) through at least 44280s. No '第四回' title card appears before that point in the queried range, so the clue interval sits unambiguously inside Chapter 3. The reference answer 'Chapter 3' is well supported.

what_worked: All 5 rollouts used the same effective pattern: semantic_search across multiple tables (episodes/event_steps/topic_facts/visual_clips) to locate the curio-related clip, then targeted run_sql windowed queries (start_s BETWEEN clue-adjacent bounds) on visual_clips to find the exact talisman-menu caption naming 兽与佛.

All rollouts additionally ran a run_sql search for chapter title-card text ('第%回%'/'title card'/'chapter') to confirm the chapter number independently of the item-menu clip, rather than inferring the chapter from proximity alone.

The visual_clips captioning was detailed enough (naming the specific talisman '兽与佛' inside the menu clip text) that no clip_qa visual sub-agent call was needed in any of the 5 rollouts — the retrieval agent solved this purely from existing captions/SQL.

The judge scored all 5 as correct despite verbose, sometimes inconsistent subtitle-text framing (夜生白露 vs 风都黄昏 vs New West/小西天) in the free-text answers, because the reference answer is just 'Chapter 3' and all 5 answers correctly stated Chapter 3.
transferable_lessons: For 'which chapter' questions, cross-check both (a) the item/event's own visual_clips or episode caption and (b) a title-card / chapter-marker search (ILIKE on '第%回%'/'chapter'/'title card') anchored to the nearest chapter boundary, rather than trusting a single source.
When a jsonb ->> query on a text column errors out (malformed JSON), falling back to CAST(text AS VARCHAR) ILIKE is a reliable retry pattern that several rollouts used successfully.

Detailed visual_clips captions that name specific in-game item/menu text (e.g. an item's Chinese name shown in an inventory screen) can make a clip_qa visual sub-agent call unnecessary — check caption text before spending a visual call.
open_questions: The exact chapter subtitle name differs across rollouts (夜生白露 / 风都黄昏 / 风起黄昏) because the in-game chapter subtitle text itself appears to drift/vary in different caption occurrences of '第三回' in the source video (OCR or streaming overlay variance); this did not affect scoring since only the chapter number was judged, but the true canonical subtitle for Chapter 3 was not independently resolved here.
